title: docs(permissions): name declared membershipKeys in the RLS guide's context variables
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8FiD8VYiNjD9zPG48Gh7MbM)_

Fixes #26423

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:RLS 指南「Context variables」表新增 `current_user.KEY` 一行(链到参考页「Where a membership key comes from」),并重写表后的收尾段:先讲在名册对象上声明 `membershipKeys`,附一个经类型检查的门户示例,再讲部署侧注册 membership resolver 作为扩展。
- 为什么改:做门户/合作伙伴访问的作者先读这页指南,旧文只说「部署可注入成员集合」,把他们引向写插件或逐行写策略,而一条 `membershipKeys` 声明就能解决;参考页与 data 技能早已写明,只缺指南。
- 风险与回滚:仅改一个手写文档文件,不发布任何包、不动运行时;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx` 的 Context variables 一节(新表行与收尾段、示例代码块)。
- 两分钟验证:`grep -c membershipKeys content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx`,预期 3;`pnpm check:doc-anchors`,预期全部片段链接解析通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx`, section `## Context variables` only:

- The table gains a `current_user.KEY` row: a set a roster object declares under `membershipKeys`, linked to [`/docs/references/security/rls#where-a-membership-key-comes-from`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/content/docs/references/security/rls.mdx).
- The closing paragraph ("Deployments can inject additional membership sets ...") is rewritten to name both sources in the order `packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts` gives them: a declared key first (`userField`, `valueField`, optional `filter` on the roster object), with one checked example (an `account_member` roster plus a portal permission set reading `account in current_user.portal_account_ids`), then a registered membership resolver as the deployment-side extension. It also carries the runtime facts the spec states: read once per request as a system read in the caller's organization, no read on the roster needed, whoever writes roster rows grants the key, a key both sources claim resolves from neither, and an unsupplied key or one over 1,000 values matches no rows.

Shape of truth: `MembershipKeySchema` / `MembershipKeysSchema` and the module docblock's "Where a membership key comes from" in `packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts`, and `ObjectSchema.membershipKeys` in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`. The example mirrors the one `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` already type-checks.

## Why

The guide is the page an author reads first; it sent them to a deployment-side resolver for what one declared key does. On `origin/main` 1080f074 the guide had 0 `membershipKeys` hits while the reference page carried the key.

## Tests

Docs-only. The new example carries the `os:check` marker, so `check:skill-examples` type-checks it against the built `@objectstack/spec` declarations.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance: the table carries the `current_user.KEY` row with the link; `grep -c membershipKeys content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx` = 3; the anchor resolves (`check:doc-anchors` green). The docs build is CI's `Build Docs` job (not run locally).
- Observed, not fixed (outside the card's surface): the guide's kernel rows list five values, while `rls.zod.ts` names a sixth the kernel resolves, `accessible_org_ids`. Noted only.

## Verification

All gates run at head `c03a2d59` (the only commit; base `1080f074`).

<details><summary>Derived gate set: 45 derived, 45 run, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 45 commands from the one-path change set; every one ran with exit 0. `check:skill-examples` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `packages/client-react/dist` unbuilt); after building `@objectstack/client-react` and its dependencies it answered exit 0 with "266 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)". `check:doc-anchors`: "621 internal #fragment link(s) across 430 source file(s) all resolve to a real heading". `check:role-word`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0. Reconciliation (`--ran`): "45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

</details>

Not measured locally, left to CI: `Build Docs`, the type-check lanes, `Plan Test Core shards`.
